result: The saved post-deployment isolated fixture raster is pixel-identical to the R731 candidate and visibly uses the adapted flat body profile. This supports the native GTK2 fixture rendering after deployment. Because the capture invocation did not preserve its exact RC environment and it is not a live user application, it cannot establish that an already-open application repainted or supply human visual acceptance.
next: Keep R731 in place and do not reinstall. I167 remains open for a fresh view of an already-open GTK2 application after the reload and the user's visual assessment. If it still reads outward, capture that exact whole control and isolate the remaining edge before changing the profile.
